## [Unreleased] — 2026-10-11

### T-183: the owner proceeds past the top-of-list lean; T-200 opened (2026-11-06)

- **Decision.** After the second pilot (plan §13.5), the owner decided to proceed to the main phase as is: the order
  is shuffled, so the lean favours no option, and each choice's position is recorded, so the lean is reported and
  controlled for in the analysis. Recorded for later review as T-200 (`docs/todo/2026-11-03_version_3_llm_agent_experiment.md`):
  position 1 at 12 against 6.6 by chance, the first two positions 32 against 13.3; the stronger rule fails only on
  that lean; the report computes the approved rule and not the stronger one; possible fixes listed.
- **Documents.** The plan (status line, §11 step 7, §13.5), the README, T-183's record, `docs/REVIEWER_READING_LIST.md`,
  `TODO.md` (generated). No code changed; no live call. The main phase's cost go-ahead is separate.

### T-183 step 7: the second pilot, in the shuffled order (2026-11-06)

- **The owner's decisions.** The go-ahead for the second pilot, and the stronger "effect gone" rule for §13.5 of
  `docs/plan_v3_llm_agent_experiment.md`: gone only if same-option repeats exceed same-id repeats, same-id repeats are
  not above chance (the sum of `1/N` over the pairs), and the position-1 and last-position shares are not above the
  mean of `1/N`. Both asked through `AskUserQuestion`, both as recommended.
- **Run.** `pilot2-A1-s1` (A1, seed 1, 26 weeks, `claude-haiku-5-5`, `option_order` `shuffled`): `complete`, 182
  calls, 0 re-asks, fallbacks, retries or failures, $0.029782 against the estimate's $0.0373, from the `main` pool.
  `runner replay`: every run `complete`, `pilot-A1-s1` at its summary hash `d94482be4672`. The report regenerated.
- **Result.** Position 1 at 0.066 against a mean `1/N` of 0.036, last position 0.022; same id 7 against 6.4 by chance
  and 108 same-option pairs of 175; holds 0.951; `K1` at 0.033, K14 0.280 the largest. The fixed-id habit and the
  `K1` preference of the first pilot are gone; a lean toward the top of the list is not (first tenth 0.214). The
  effect does not count as gone under either rule; the main phase waits and the result goes to the owner.
- **Documents.** The plan (status line, §10's LX.L2 row, §11 step 7, §13.4, §13.5), `experiments/llm_agents/README.md`,
  T-183's record, `docs/REVIEWER_READING_LIST.md`, the report (generated). This changelog's oldest entry moved to
  `docs/CHANGELOG_archive.md`, verbatim. Nothing under `src/bowen/` or `config/bowen/`; the engine hash is unchanged
  (`0b363cb3186c`).
- **Suite.** Before the run: 1427 tests, 1425 pass, 2 strict expected failures.

### T-183 step 7: the option-order fix built (2026-11-06)

- **Built.** The plan's §13, no live call. `option_order` in `experiments/llm_agents/config/llm.md` (`shuffled`) and
  in the run record; each round's options presorted by mechanics and shuffled together, acts and holds, by
  `arms.py::option_rng`, keyed by `(seed, week, person token)` and not the arm, outside the engine's draw service
  (`prompts.py::arranged`); ids the shuffled positions; the prompt carries the numbered options' mechanics
  (`Prompt.specs`) and `source.py::_select` maps the id through them. The phase `pilot2` (A1, seed 1, 26 weeks,
  `claude-haiku-5-5`, pool `main`; run id `pilot2-A1-s1`). Each complete LLM run writes `choices.jsonl.gz`, outside
  its summary; the report gains the position readout of §13.4 (`report.py::position_readout`), with the same-id
  repeats a position-blind choice would give by chance, the last-position share and the flagged weeks beside the
  owner's rule (from the review). A live run resumed in another order than it began in is refused.
- **Tests.** LX.21–LX.26 (12 tests, one guarding a resumed run's order), each proved failing by the mutation §13.3 names, then restored. LX.10's field
  list and LX.1's file set grew by `option_order` and `choices.jsonl.gz`.
- **Replay.** `runner replay`: every committed run `complete`; `pilot-A1-s1`, whose record has no `option_order`,
  replays in the fixed order to its committed summary hash `d94482be4672`, and the replay wrote its
  `choices.jsonl.gz`. Its readout: 182 choices, position 1 at 0.011 against a mean 1/N of 0.036, 148 same-id and 173
  same-option pairs of 175, holds 0.989, every choice on token `K1`. In the fixed order this does not tell position
  from content; the second pilot does.
- **Found, not fixed.** During an I-POSITION sequence the engine makes a member's act toward the sequence's other as
  `STAY-IN-CONTACT` (`src/bowen/engine/iposition.py`), so in a few rounds the act run is not the one the agent chose;
  recorded in the plan's §12.
- **Documents.** The plan (status line, §8, §10, §11 step 7, §12, §13), `experiments/llm_agents/README.md`, T-183's

  moved verbatim to `docs/CHANGELOG_archive.md` for the size limit.
- **Not changed.** Nothing under `src/bowen/` or `config/bowen/`; the engine hash stays `0b363cb3186c`. Suite:

### T-183: the option-order proposal (2026-11-06)

- **Proposed.** The plan's new §13: the fix for the list-position effect the pilot found (148 of 175 week-to-week
  pairs repeat the same id; the first hold chosen by six of seven members). One shuffle per person per round over
  acts and holds together, presorted by mechanics and keyed by `(seed, week, person token)` under its own purpose,
  outside the engine's draw service; ids the shuffled positions; `option_order` in `llm.md` and the run record, a
  missing field read as `fixed`, so the committed pilot still replays; criteria LX.21–LX.26, each with the mutation
  that must fail it; a position readout per LLM arm in the report; a second pilot the size of LX.L2 (182 calls, about
  $0.04) and the direction that counts as the effect gone.
- **Decided.** The owner answered §13's seven questions 2026-11-06, each as recommended (§13.6).
- **Documents.** The plan (status line, §11 step 7, §13), T-183's record, `docs/REVIEWER_READING_LIST.md`;
  regenerated: `TODO.md` and this file's index.
- **Not changed.** No code and no live call; the build is the next session. Nothing under `src/bowen/` or
  `config/bowen/`; the engine hash stays `0b363cb3186c`.

### T-183 step 7: the pilot LX.L2 (2026-11-06)

- **Checked first.** The prices in `experiments/llm_agents/config/llm.md` against the pricing page
  (`platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing`), read 2026-11-06: `claude-haiku-5-5` $0.10 / $0.50 per MTok for
  prompts up to 100,000 tokens, `claude-sonnet-5-5` $2 / $10; they match. The smoke call's open item: the `sampling`
  line cited API version `2026-10-21`, but the client sends `2023-06-01` (SDK 0.78.0). At `2023-06-01` both models
  return a 400 for any non-default `temperature`, `top_p` or `top_k` (a model rule); at `2026-10-21` any value is a
  400 on every model. The request sends none, so it did not change; the wording was corrected in `record.py`'s
  `SAMPLING`, `llm.md` and the plan's §4 (the experiment's code hash moved, not the engine hash). The smoke call's
  record keeps the first wording, as it was made.
- **Run.** `python3 -m experiments.llm_agents.runner run pilot --live`, once, on the owner's go-ahead of 2026-11-06:
  A1, seed 1, 26 weeks, `claude-haiku-5-5`. Status `complete`, 26 of 26 weeks; 182 calls, every one HTTP 200 and
  `end_turn`; 0 re-asks, 0 fallbacks (share 0.0 against `max_fallback_share` 0.01), 0 retries, 0 failures. Cost
  $0.029851 against the estimate's $0.041. `runner replay`, with the key unset, replays it `complete` from the cache.
- **LX.L2: tokens.** Input per call: mean 1,590, median 1,483, min 799, max 2,337; it rises with the history over the
  first 15 weeks and is level at about 1,700 after. Output: 10 tokens on every call. No cache reads or writes. Sized
  offline for 208 weeks with the suite's stub chooser (no call), scaled by the pilot's tokens per character: mean
  about 1,716 (A1), 2,068 (A2), 2,128 (A3), 1,742 (A4), max about 3,200; A1's opaque tokens pack densely, so A2's and
  A3's figures are likely high. Restated in `llm.md` as the plan's §10 says: `estimate_input_tokens` 2,000
  (unchanged), `estimate_output_tokens` 50 → 10. The main phase is now 29,120 calls × $0.000205 = $5.97, against the
  main pool's $9.97 left ($0.029964 spent: the smoke call and the pilot); the cross-check 5,824 calls × $0.0041 =
  $23.88 against $35 (its model's output not yet measured).
- **LX.L2: outputs, against §3.** The banned-term lint finds nothing in the 21 stored real prompts. No theory term
  and no contamination sign in the prompts read. Found, for the owner: the model chooses by list position. Six of
  the seven members give the same option id almost every week, and it is the first "hold back from" option
  (`hold back from: K1 toward …`); P2 and P4 chose option 1 in week 0, the first act on the list, which in seed 1 is
  `K1` = `CUTOFF`, so both broke off contact with P1 in the first week. Options are numbered in a fixed order
  (`prompts.py::ordered_options`: acts by target and label, then holds), and `K1` sorts first. 9 distinct option ids
  in 182 choices. No prompt was changed; the decision is the owner's.
- **Tests.** Two fixtures assumed no pilot run: `test_budget.py::test_lx11_estimate_over_cap_refuses` hard-coded the
  50-token output (it now reads the config), and `test_report.py`'s synthetic report copied every seed-1 summary,
  now including the pilot's A1 (it now copies A0 only). The report is regenerated and unchanged: the pilot is not in
  the comparison.
- **Documents.** The plan (status line, §4, LX.L2's row, §11 step 7), the experiment's README, `llm.md`, T-183's
  record, `docs/REVIEWER_READING_LIST.md`; regenerated: `docs/llm_agent_experiment_report.md`, `TODO.md` and this
  file's index. The two oldest entries (version 2's definition, step 7, and the stage-end sweep on revision 43's
  engine, both 2026-10-30) moved to `docs/CHANGELOG_archive.md` verbatim.
- **Not changed.** Nothing under `src/bowen/` or `config/bowen/`; the engine hash stays `0b363cb3186c`. The main
  phase waits for the owner's go-ahead.

### Version 3, part 2: the LLM-agent experiment built, plan steps 1–6 (T-183) (2026-11-06)

- **What.** `docs/plan_v3_llm_agent_experiment.md` §11 steps 1–6, under `experiments/llm_agents/` (its README): the
  config loaders and five config files; the arms A0–A4 with each seed's tokens and A3's derangement; the pure prompt
  renderer and the banned-term lint; `LLMSource`, the engine `Source` that has each living family member choose its
  week's outcome from the policy's legal set through a chooser while the external agent stays on the policy; the
  client (cache first, one retry loop, the parse and one re-ask; the SDK imported lazily, its own retries off, pinned
  `anthropic==2.6.0`); the gzipped per-run response cache; the budget's estimate and per-round worst case; the run
  record of §8; the summary, the report and the command line. Tests under `tests/experiments/llm_agents/`, 75, each
  named for its LX ID; no test calls the API. The A0 baseline (no call, no cost) was run for its five seeds and is
  committed with the generated report, `docs/llm_agent_experiment_report.md`.
- **Reviews (step 6).** One learning-qa pass, one correctness pass and a security review of the client layer (no
  finding at confidence 8 or above). Fixed in the same batch, each with a test: replay skipped runs that never
  finished instead of relabelling them `not_replayable` (P1), and now compares the replayed summary with the committed
  one, so a change that leaves every prompt the same is caught; spend is summed from the response caches, so a run that
  crashed before its record still counts (P6); a fully cached round is not charged against the cap, and the estimate
  is checked against the total cap as well; the Models check goes through the retry loop (P5); a `retry-after` longer
  than the backoff cap is honoured up to `retry_after_max_seconds`; the runs not started are written to
  `runs/phase-<name>.json` (P2); the change after an act in the history is measured to the person's next round; the
  worst case counts the output schema; key-shaped test strings are built at run time; the root `.gitignore`'s `runs/`
  is anchored to the root, so the experiment's runs are tracked. Left for the owner: A4 removes the tension line and
  the history's changes, but the tie strain and believed pair tension lines, which move after the agent's own acts,
  still show (§2's intent against LX.7's wording).
- **Beyond the plan, named at build.** Two more config files, `prompt_text.md` and `report_text.md`, so that no prompt
  or report wording is in code; the status `stopped_permanent`; the A0 arm includes the standard spells, as the
  ensemble's assembly does (LX.17). The plan's §5, §6, §7, §8 and §12 say so.
- **Documents.** The plan (status line, §5, §6, §7, §8, §12), the experiment's README, T-183's record,
  `docs/REVIEWER_READING_LIST.md`, `docs/SPEC_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md` (the five config files and the report), `CLAUDE.md`
  (the suite count), `requirements.txt`; regenerated: `docs/spec_coverage.md` (the new tests, under "named for no
  spec ID"), `TODO.md` and this file's index. `tests/test_doc_checklist.py` covers the experiment's config directory,
  `tests/doc_claims.json` dates the earlier entries' 1340-test phrases, and `tests/test_version_1_outputs.py` allows the report, whose framing block uses the term "virtual family" to deny it.
- **Not changed.** No live call was made. The plain-label and prompt wording (`act_labels.md`, `prompt_text.md`) wait
  for the owner (Q2), and step 7 (the smoke call LX.L1, the pilot LX.L2, the main phase, the cross-check) for the
  owner's go-ahead. Nothing under `src/bowen/` or `config/bowen/`; the engine hash stays `0b363cb3186c`. Suite: 1415
  tests, 1413 pass, 2 strict expected failures.

### Spec revision 54: `M11.5`'s note for `M11.C.42` names the relieved receiver (T-199) (2026-11-06)

- **What.** `M11.5`'s note for `M11.C.42` said reuse is read with `M4.C.1d`'s contact "returned to a relieved
  seeker". `M4.C.1d` returns part of a delivered contact to its sender when the delivery relieves its receiver, so the
  note now says the contact is returned to its sender by a relieved receiver, as T-171's version 2 note does. Spec
  revision 54, wording in `M11` only; no rule, class, verdict or status changed. `docs/SPEC_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md`'s
  summary of stage 3's plan had the same slip ("a relieved sender's tie") and is corrected. Claude's recommendation
  under the owner's instruction to proceed, pending the owner's review.

  them (this Mac, `nice -n 15`, 8 workers, 19 min), reproduces the record's `negative_run` (−0.319 ± 0.104 and
  −0.113 ± 0.062) and sets the cut tie's run against other baselines (`docs/review/t176_negative_run_trace.md`). The
  readout counts an uncut tie only if it had a contact by the cutoff's week but counts a cut tie with none at a run of 0;
  with the same condition on both arms the difference is +0.029 ± 0.136 (Phase B family) and +0.344 ± 0.078
  (twelve-person family). Matching the uncut ties on relation does not remove the reversal. On cut ties with a
  contact, the twelve-person family's run lengthens more than the uncut ties' over 13 and 52 weeks; the Phase B
  family's does not differ. The review passes found the run-before rows carried the same bias; they were
  restricted to cut ties with a contact and the trace rerun once (20 min). The owner restated both
  disposition rows through `AskUserQuestion` and opened T-179 (whether the readout should read both arms alike). Read
  only: no rule, readout or record changed, and the engine hash (`09ca2b46c7e0`) did not move.
